title: Like Moths
art: 101:4-5: on the Day of the Striking Calamity people will be like moths, dispersed, and the mountains like wool, fluffed up; then the scales are weighed, and one whose scales are heavy will be in a pleasant life.
Nobody is shown: the moths are points of light, the mountains are the ones fluffed like wool, and the scales are never drawn.
The look of the fluffed mountains is imagined.
imagePrompt: A plain under a pale sky with ranks of mountains standing pale and soft, as though fluffed like wool; and around them, thousands of small lights drifting and scattering like moths in a lamplight; ink-wash and parchment texture.

beats.say: On the Day of the Striking Calamity, the Quran says, people will be like moths, dispersed. And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
The mountains stand pale and soft, and the lights of people drift and scatter through the air like moths. Then the scales are weighed. The Quran says no more about the weighing than that it happens.

verse.en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed, And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
